import pytest


def config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str:
    """Return the value for `key` in name=value config text, or "" if absent."""
    result = ""
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        k, sep, v = line.partition("=")
        if not sep:
            continue
        if k.strip() == key:
            result = v.strip()
    return result


def test_config_value_present() -> None:
    text = "host=localhost\nport=8080\ndebug=true"
    assert config_value(text, "host") == "localhost"
    assert config_value(text, "port") == "8080"
    assert config_value(text, "debug") == "true"


def test_config_value_missing() -> None:
    text = "host=localhost\nport=8080"
    assert config_value(text, "missing") == ""
    assert config_value("", "host") == ""


def test_config_value_whitespace_and_empty_lines() -> None:
    text = "\n  host =  127.0.0.1  \n\n  timeout = 30 \n"
    assert config_value(text, "host") == "127.0.0.1"
    assert config_value(text, "timeout") == "30"


def test_config_value_empty_value() -> None:
    text = "flag=\nother=val"
    assert config_value(text, "flag") == ""


def test_config_value_contains_equals() -> None:
    text = "url=https://example.com/api?a=1&b=2\ntoken=abc=123"
    assert config_value(text, "url") == "https://example.com/api?a=1&b=2"
    assert config_value(text, "token") == "abc=123"


def test_config_value_duplicate_key_prefers_last() -> None:
    text = "retries=1\nretries=3"
    assert config_value(text, "retries") == "3"


def test_config_value_ignores_comments_and_malformed_lines() -> None:
    text = "# comment\nno_equal_sign\nkey=val"
    assert config_value(text, "key") == "val"
    assert config_value(text, "# comment") == ""
